description: Published 10-K values for NVIDIA Corporation (CIK 0001045810). Values sourced from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts and verified against 10-K filings. A 10:1 stock split occurred on June 10, 2024; per-share and share-count values are noted with their split basis.

validation_notes.capex_concept_change: NVIDIA switched from PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment to PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets around FY2023. The latter includes property, equipment, and intangible assets. FY2023 capex was first reported as a comparative in the FY2024 10-K.
validation_notes.split_adjustment: NVIDIA executed a 10:1 stock split on June 10, 2024. FY2023 and FY2024 per-share values have both pre-split (as originally reported) and post-split (restated in FY2025 10-K) variants. FY2025 values are natively post-split.
validation_notes.fcf_derivation: Free cash flow is derived as operating_cash_flow minus capex (PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets). This is not a direct XBRL concept.
validation_notes.cash_and_investments: cash_and_short_term_investments is derived as CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue + MarketableSecuritiesCurrent. Does not include non-current investments.
validation_notes.total_debt_composition: total_debt uses the LongTermDebt XBRL concept which includes both current and non-current portions. Verified against LongTermDebtNoncurrent + DebtCurrent for each year.
validation_notes.regression_key_value: FY2025 revenue of $130,497,000,000 is the critical regression test value. The original pipeline misparse returned ~$26.974B (a quarterly/YTD value) instead of the correct annual total.
